product_one_liner.value: SnapLogic is an AI-powered, low-code integration platform that helps enterprise IT and business teams connect applications, data, APIs and AI agents and automate workflows.

eng_blog.notes: Engineer-authored posts explain the internal analytics architecture (Indrajeet Kane, June 18, 2025) and E-Pods development infrastructure (Nilay Narlawar, March 31, 2026).

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Applied AI Architect; the posting describes a fractional contract engagement working on production LLM and AI-agent deployments.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude Sonnet through Amazon Bedrock; AgentCreator also supports OpenAI, Azure OpenAI and Google Gemini.
model_provider.notes: The SnapGPT FAQ explicitly identifies AWS Bedrock Claude Sonnet as an example of models it uses; the additional providers are documented AgentCreator connections.

compliance_certs.notes: These are public claims, not independent certification verification. The security page names SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA-HITECH and GDPR compliance; the financial-services resource additionally claims ISO 27001 and PCI DSS certification. GDPR and HIPAA are compliance frameworks rather than conventional certifications.

last_funding.notes: Latest dated financing listed by PitchBook: completed Debt - General on August 13, 2025; amount is undisclosed. PitchBook also lists an undated secondary transaction, which cannot be chronologically ranked. The latest publicly announced priced equity round located was the $165 million Series H on December 13, 2021; that amount is not attributed to the debt financing.

raised_18mo.notes: Window: May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. PitchBook lists completed debt financing dated August 13, 2025, but no corresponding dated funding announcement or filing was located. The verified company funding announcement is from December 2021, so neither a categorical false nor an announcement-backed true is established.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Senior Enterprise Account Executive has a live application posting.

launched_6mo.notes: July 29, 2026: introduced the new SnapGPT agentic assistant for the integration lifecycle, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated executive-movement notice posted September 22, 2026 reports that Chief Financial Officer Ahsan Malik left the company, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Field Marketing Manager posting explicitly requires Salesforce CRM, Marketo and Outreach; the account-executive posting requires Salesforce opportunity and activity management.
